issues.title: Truncated JSON Schema and Missing Template Files
issues.why: The context cap truncated the normative JSON Schema (schemas/powershell.schema.json) and the 855-line template (templates/run.ps1) is referenced but not provided in the text.
issues.fix: Provide the full text of schemas/powershell.schema.json and templates/run.ps1 within the spec context.

issues.title: Unresolved External Script Dependencies
issues.why: The spec references 'upload-plugin-v2.ps1' and 'upload-plugin-U-Q.ps1' as core to the upload functionality, but their contracts/interfaces are not defined here.
issues.fix: Include the interface contracts or full source for the referenced upload scripts.

issues.title: Concurrency Race Conditions in Multi-Site Upload
issues.why: The 'Parallel Work Sync Output' pattern uses Start-Job but doesn't address potential race conditions if multiple jobs attempt to write to the same log file or shared pnpm store.
issues.fix: Add a requirement for per-job unique log paths and explicit file locking for shared resources.
